propositions: Negative caplog assertions (assert not / assert any with negation) pass silently when zero records are captured, making coverage loss invisible and indistinguishable from genuine verification.

Logger level is raised to WARNING on the shared rebar logger by install_stderr_handler() and never restored, causing INFO-level assertions on downstream tests to silently fail to capture records and pass vacuously.
Test execution order determines whether a caplog assertion is void or live in the same commit, since logger state leaks across tests without restoration, making coverage non-reproducible across runs.

An autouse fixture guard that snapshots and restores both logger propagation and level at test setup/teardown eliminates the silent fail-open by making violations audible and containing state leakage.
Five identified negative assertions are currently void-vulnerable and must either be verified live or deleted; vacuous green assertions are not acceptable.
